leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node class with val and neighbors properties to represent graph nodes
Initialize a Map to track visited nodes during graph traversal
Implement a depth-first search function to traverse the original graph
Apply recursive logic to create cloned nodes and connect their neighbors
Manipulate the Map to store and retrieve cloned nodes efficiently
Configure the cloneGraph function to return the cloned graph's entry point
Integrate the DFS traversal with the cloning process in a single function
